answer: Work-slot bond burn bars fakes from the job queue. Claiming a slot burns a 50 POA bond, and each slot runs one work thread. The delta is stark: one honest agent pays 50 POA, while 100 fakes burn 5,000 POA for 100 slots. Slots last 20 epochs, so one bond covers dozens of paid jobs, while a faker keeps paying. Only bond-burners reach the summit of the queue, where attested work waits; unvouched threads earn nothing, so fakes lose on every slot.
